1.insights: Assuming willingness to pay is spread evenly from 0 to 4.51 (a simple placeholder, not verified), expected profit (p - 1)(1 - p/4.51) peaks near p = 2.76, with profit about 0.68 per potential customer. The optimum sits well below the 4.51 ceiling because each extra unit of price costs volume. This assumption must be checked against real sales data. Starting at 2.75 gives a reasonable first read on demand.
